newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 5.16 million barrels in the week ended Dec 20 to 292.87 million barrels from 298.03 million barrels in the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Thursday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 3.85 million barrels in the week to 230.92 million barrels from 234.77 million.
Distillate stocks fell 1.89 million barrels to 121.33 million from 123.22 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 800,000 barrels to 46.26 million barrels from 45.46 million.
It said gasoline production fell 116,000 barrels in the week to 7.59 million bpd from 7.71 million bpd.
Gasoline stocks rose 504,000 barrels in the week to 191.97 million barrels from 191.46 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 93.3 percent in the week from 93.5 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 1.84 million barrels to 36.23 million barrels from 38.07 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units fell to 14.21 million barrels from 14.28 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 43.54 million barrels from 44.19 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 7.25 million barrels per day from 7.86 million, API said.
